documentary.hero_p: Plan. Adapt. Organize stories that evolve in the real world. Pzaz brings planning, narrative development, collaboration, and logistics into one connected workspace built for real-world storytelling.
documentary.problem_title: Documentaries don't follow a fixed script.
documentary.problem_title_red: Most tools weren't built for that.
documentary.problem_desc: Narratives evolve during filming. Locations change. Research deepens. Editorial direction shifts. Without a connected workflow, managing these moving parts becomes overwhelming.
documentary.problem_card_title: The friction that slows real stories down.
documentary.problem_item1: Research notes, scripts, and shot lists live in separate places
documentary.problem_item2: Narrative changes don't propagate to the production plan
documentary.problem_item3: Long-form projects lose coherence across extended timelines
documentary.problem_item4: Collaboration breaks down between field crew and editorial
documentary.problem_tagline: Fragmentation costs creative energy. Pzaz brings it all together.
documentary.promise_h1: Pzaz doesn't cage your story in a rigid structure.
documentary.promise_h2: It gives your story room to breathe and evolve.
documentary.promise_p: Pzaz centralizes the entire documentary process into one environment. Filmmakers gain clarity across planning, storytelling, and production coordination without sacrificing creative flexibility.
documentary.tools_desc: Support storytelling that develops over time. Documentary production requires adaptability, structure, and collaboration across extended timelines.
documentary.tool1_desc: Documentary storytelling evolves through research, interviews, and discovery. Pzaz allows filmmakers to adapt narrative structures while preserving clarity.
documentary.tool1_highlight: Stories develop organically without losing direction.
documentary.tool2_desc: Documentary narratives often unfold in unexpected ways. Pzaz provides tools to structure content dynamically while maintaining coherence.
documentary.tool2_highlight: Explore narrative possibilities without losing the thread.
documentary.tool3_desc: Docuseries and multi-episode documentaries require coordination across complex editorial and production timelines.
documentary.tool3_highlight: Maintain consistency across narrative arcs and production workflows.
documentary.tool4_desc: Documentary filmmaking frequently involves dispersed locations and evolving logistics. Pzaz integrates location planning tools that help filmmakers adapt quickly.
documentary.tool4_highlight: Coordinate real-world production with the precision it demands.
documentary.add_desc: Support the full lifecycle of documentary development. Documentary production demands adaptability at every stage.
documentary.add1_desc: Create shot lists, production schedules, and planning frameworks that adapt as new information emerges.
documentary.add1_highlight: Build workflows that move with your story, not against it.
documentary.add2_desc: Pzaz enables seamless collaboration so updates, feedback, and creative decisions remain connected to the project itself.
documentary.add2_highlight: Stay in sync across time zones, shoots, and editorial phases.
documentary.add3_desc: Pzaz provides tools that help filmmakers integrate new angles and insights while maintaining narrative clarity throughout the project.
documentary.add3_highlight: Respond to discovery without losing direction.
documentary.ai_subtitle: Support narrative development with intelligent analysis.
documentary.ai_p: Pzaz brings AI tools that help documentary filmmakers analyse narrative structure, identify story gaps and surface patterns across research materials — without taking creative decisions away from the filmmaker.
documentary.cta_h2: Ready to Bring Your Documentary Vision to Life?
documentary.cta_p: Work within a connected environment that adapts to the unpredictable nature of documentary filmmaking.
